limitations: Only one of five frozen centered twins tested; not a complete S02 ensemble.
TF-IDF-only clustering approximates mixed GLM/lexical S02 clustering.
Quantized cached features; not bitwise reproduction of fp32 S02 extraction.
Public OOF components use source seed0 folds; centering test uses our archived GroupKFold folds. They are not blended.
Historical development reuse remains; no official submission or paid/GPU run.
